glosses: Ajouter un préfixe (à un mot, en particulier).

examples.text: Ce mot peut se préfixer ou circonfixer avec ber ou me- + -kan.

glosses: A morpheme added to the beginning of a word to modify its meaning, for example as, pre- in prefix, con- in conjure, re- in reheat, etc.

examples.text: The chosen prefixes won the vote in part because they start with the only two letters left in the alphabet that are not already used in measurement. The b for “bronto” is already used for bytes and h for “hella” is used for hecto, the prefix for 100.

glosses: A set of digits placed before a telephone number, to indicate where the number is based, what type of phone number it is (landline, mobile, toll-free, premium rate etc.)

examples.text: in the UK, a number with an 0800 prefix is a toll-free number.
Add the prefix +34 to dial a Spanish number from abroad

glosses: A title added to a person's name, such as Mr. or Dr.
An initial segment of a string of characters.

examples.text: The string "abra" is both a prefix and a suffix of the string "abracadabra".

glosses: To determine beforehand; to set in advance.

examples.text: But the danger was, that a man can hardly prefix any certaine limits unto his desire[…].
It is important to realize that pregivenness or prefixing is a kind of anteriority that does its work in the present; subjects and meanings in part emerge in enuciative co-constitutive moments.

glosses: To put or fix before, or at the beginning of something; to place at the start.
Fijar, determinar, establecer, indicar, señalar, precisar o estipular algo de antemano (con anticipación, antes de otro evento).

examples.text: Al mismo tiempo se prefijó el día 1° del mes de septiembre de 1815 para la apertura del congreso

glosses: Colocar un afijo al comienzo de una palabra (un prefijo), para formar otra o modificar su significado.
